_comment: V3 combat numbers (spec sections 3.2-3.8). Edit freely; DataDB reloads them on start.

burn_power._about: Permanent power of burned memories (scripts/combat/burn_power.gd). weight >= charge_weight: +charge_ember max Köz (one more Köz Darbesi). weight 1: per hit / per kill Köz from light_curve by the order of the burn; past the end the last step repeats (never zero). Balance rule: every slice encounter is beatable at base values (no burns).

balance_check._about: The balance rule (STORY_SLICE §2): every slice encounter is comfortably beatable at base values (100 Köz, 2 Köz Darbesi, no burns). scripts/debug/balance_selftest.gd plays each one with a plain, deliberately average bot (walks in, attacks no faster than attack_interval, dodges only dodge_chance of the windups it sees, drinks below drink_below, a Köz Darbesi when strike_when_near enemies crowd it; reaction: seconds before it goes for a new target) and requires a win with at least min_health left and at most max_flasks used, in every seed. allies: who fights beside him from the start; companions the story's beats bring in (move_npc:<id>:party) join as they would in the game.

encounters._about: Solo at first; Rüfət joins through the act 1 beats (wave 2, or Aras under 30%), as in the script.
